title: Implement an LRU cache in Go
description: Implement LRUCache with Get(key int) (int, bool) and Put(key, value int). Capacity-limited; evicts least-recently-used entry on overflow. Use a doubly-linked list + map.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement LRUCache in lru.go using a doubly-linked list + map:
- Node struct: key, val, prev, next *Node
- LRUCache: capacity int, cache map[int]*Node, head/tail sentinel nodes (head.next=oldest, tail.prev=newest)
- `New`: initialize head/tail sentinels linked together, empty map
- `Get`: if not in map return -1,false; move node to front (tail side); return val,true
- `Put`: if key exists update val and move to front; else add new node at front; if len>capacity remove head.next (LRU)
All 4 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
